title: A billion users have enabled passkeys on WhatsApp — plus a new call-screening feature! 🔐
body: A billion users have enabled passkeys on WhatsApp — plus a new call-screening feature! 🔐

WhatsApp announced today that more than a billion users have enabled passkeys on their accounts. Anyone signed in on Android or iPhone can now add more than one passkey to their account, and two-step verification now accepts a full password — longer, with letters, numbers, and symbols — instead of a short code. The app also announced a new, smarter call-screening feature on Android.

A passkey means signing in with your fingerprint or face instead of a code sent by text message — much faster and much harder to steal. And call screening is like a doorman for your phone: it checks unknown callers before your phone even rings.
Have you enabled passkeys on WhatsApp? 📲
